# Copilot Instructions

## Project Goal
Build a simple mobile calculator app that adds two numbers and displays the result.

## Constraints
- Follow the approved SDD spec exactly.
- Do not add login, backend, or persistent history features unless explicitly requested.
- Prefer a modular design around calculation logic and UI rendering.
- Keep code understandable, testable, and aligned with .NET MAUI + Blazor Hybrid.

## Workflow
- Implement the current task only.
- Validate with the smallest relevant build or test command.
- Document any necessary exceptions in the spec or plan before deviating.
